title: NSM — Honeypot
description: Phase 5: Cowrie SSH honeypot on an isolated VM — who attacks, from where, with which credentials and commands.

list.name: exclude_ip
list.label: Source IP to exclude
list.description: Hides our own validation traffic (testing/honeypot/validate.sh runs from the sensor VM's external IP) Read from nsm.lab_addresses so the address lives in .env, not in this file.

query.rawSql: SELECT address FROM nsm.lab_addresses WHERE role = 'sensor'

panels.title: Login attempts

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS attempts FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND eventid IN ('cowrie.login.failed', 'cowrie.login.success') AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}'

panels.description: Password login attempts against Cowrie (failed + accepted)

panels.title: Source IPs

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(src_ip) AS sources FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND eventid = 'cowrie.session.connect' AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}'

panels.description: Distinct addresses that opened a session

panels.title: Accepted logins

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS accepted FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND eventid = 'cowrie.login.success' AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}'

panels.description: Logins Cowrie's user database accepted (root with most passwords): the attacker then sees a fake shell

panels.title: Commands run

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS commands FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND eventid = 'cowrie.command.input' AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}'

panels.description: Commands typed or sent after an accepted login

panels.title: Countries

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(src_country_code) AS countries FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND eventid = 'cowrie.session.connect' AND src_country_code != '' AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}'

panels.description: Distinct source countries (DB-IP Lite at ingest time)

panels.title: Newest event age

targets.rawSql: SELECT dateDiff('second', max(timestamp), now64()) AS age FROM nsm.cowrie_events

panels.description: Seconds since the newest honeypot event loaded. Events arrive in batches: ~60 s on the honeypot + up to 60 s pull interval

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, if(eventid = 'cowrie.login.success', 'accepted', 'failed') AS result, count() AS attempts FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND eventid IN ('cowrie.login.failed', 'cowrie.login.success') AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}' GROUP BY time, result ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top countries

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(src_country = '', '(unknown)', src_country) AS country, uniqExact(src_ip) AS sources, countIf(eventid IN ('cowrie.login.failed', 'cowrie.login.success')) AS attempts FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}' GROUP BY country ORDER BY sources DESC, attempts DESC LIMIT 15

panels.description: Countries by distinct source IPs (DB-IP Lite, CC BY 4.0)

panels.title: Top ASNs

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(src_asn = 0, '(unknown)', concat('AS', toString(src_asn))) AS asn, any(src_as_org) AS organization, uniqExact(src_ip) AS sources, countIf(eventid IN ('cowrie.login.failed', 'cowrie.login.success')) AS attempts FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}' GROUP BY asn ORDER BY sources DESC, attempts DESC LIMIT 15

panels.description: Autonomous systems by distinct source IPs. Hosting providers dominate: most scanners run on rented servers

targets.rawSql: SELECT username, count() AS attempts, uniqExact(src_ip) AS sources FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND eventid IN ('cowrie.login.failed', 'cowrie.login.success') AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}' GROUP BY username ORDER BY attempts DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top passwords

targets.rawSql: SELECT password, count() AS attempts, uniqExact(src_ip) AS sources FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND eventid IN ('cowrie.login.failed', 'cowrie.login.success') AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}' GROUP BY password ORDER BY attempts DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Passwords tried. Attackers' guesses, not our credentials

panels.title: Top username:password pairs

targets.rawSql: SELECT username, password, count() AS attempts, uniqExact(src_ip) AS sources, countIf(eventid = 'cowrie.login.success') AS accepted FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND eventid IN ('cowrie.login.failed', 'cowrie.login.success') AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}' GROUP BY username, password ORDER BY attempts DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Credential pairs; the same pair from many sources points to a shared wordlist or botnet

panels.title: Top commands

targets.rawSql: SELECT input AS command, count() AS runs, uniqExact(src_ip) AS sources FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND eventid = 'cowrie.command.input' AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}' GROUP BY command ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Commands after an accepted login. Downloads never leave the honeypot: its VPC denies all egress except Google APIs

panels.title: SSH clients (version + HASSH)

targets.rawSql: SELECT version AS client_version, fingerprint AS hassh, count() AS sessions, uniqExact(source) AS sources FROM (SELECT session, any(src_ip) AS source, anyIf(client_version, client_version != '') AS version, anyIf(hassh, hassh != '') AS fingerprint FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND eventid IN ('cowrie.client.kex', 'cowrie.client.version') AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}' GROUP BY session) WHERE fingerprint != '' GROUP BY version, fingerprint ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: HASSH fingerprints the client's SSH key exchange offer; the same HASSH across many IPs is the same tool

panels.title: Source IPs (with sensor visits)

targets.rawSql: SELECT h.src_ip AS source, any(h.src_country_code) AS cc, any(h.src_as_org) AS organization, countIf(h.eventid IN ('cowrie.login.failed', 'cowrie.login.success')) AS login_attempts, countIf(h.eventid = 'cowrie.login.success') AS accepted, countIf(h.eventid = 'cowrie.command.input') AS commands, min(h.timestamp) AS first_seen, max(h.timestamp) AS last_seen, any(z.connections) AS sensor_connections FROM nsm.cowrie_events AS h LEFT JOIN (SELECT id_orig_h AS ip, count() AS connections FROM nsm.zeek_conn WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND NOT local_orig GROUP BY ip) AS z ON h.src_ip = z.ip WHERE $__timeFilter(h.timestamp) AND h.src_ip != '${exclude_ip}' GROUP BY h.src_ip ORDER BY login_attempts DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: sensor_connections = inbound connections from the same IP to the sensor VM (Zeek) in the same range: attackers that hit both, on two unrelated networks

panels.title: Recent logins and commands

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, src_ip, src_country_code AS cc, replaceOne(eventid, 'cowrie.', '') AS event, username, password, input AS command, session FROM nsm.cowrie_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND eventid IN ('cowrie.login.failed', 'cowrie.login.success', 'cowrie.command.input') AND src_ip != '${exclude_ip}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Latest credential attempts and commands; session links events of one connection

options.content: IP geolocation and ASN data: [DB-IP Lite](https://db-ip.com) (CC BY 4.0), looked up when events are loaded. Honeypot: Cowrie on a separate VM and VPC; logs arrive one-way through a Cloud Storage bucket.
